zh.p: 讓步就是「雖然…（但還是）…」。英文有三種常見寫法，詞性不同，後面接的東西也不同：

head: 字
詞性
後面接
例句
zh.note: 三句意思都是「雖然下雨，我們還是出門了」。

head: 寫法
句子
rows: Although he was tired, he kept working.
He was tired. However, he kept working.
despite the fact that + 子句
Despite the fact that he was tired, he kept working.

head: ✗ 錯誤
問題
✓ 正確
rows: Although it was late, but we stayed.
Although it was late, we stayed.
I was tired. Although, I finished.

zh.p: even though 比 although 更強調「即使事實如此」：Even though I studied all night, I failed.
though 可以放句尾當副詞，口語常用：It was hard. I enjoyed it, though.（不過我很享受。）

mc.q: ___ the heavy traffic, we arrived on time.
mc.zh: 儘管交通壅塞，我們還是準時到了。
mc.why: 後面是名詞片語 the heavy traffic，用介系詞 despite。

mc.q: ___ she is rich, she lives simply.
mc.zh: 雖然她很有錢，卻過得很簡樸。
mc.why: 後面是子句（she is rich），用連接詞 although。

mc.q: The plan sounds good. ___, it costs too much.
mc.zh: 這計畫聽起來不錯。然而，花費太高了。
mc.why: 句號後開始新句子，用 However + 逗號。

mc.q: In spite ___ his injury, he finished the race.
mc.zh: 儘管受了傷，他還是跑完了比賽。
mc.why: in spite of + 名詞。

mc.q: ___ being very tired, she finished the race.
mc.zh: 儘管很累，她還是跑完了比賽。
mc.why: 後面接 V-ing，用介系詞 despite。

mc.q: ___ he studied hard, he didn't pass.
mc.zh: 雖然他很用功，卻沒有及格。
mc.why: 後面接子句，用 although。

mc.q: The hotel was expensive. ___, the room was small.
mc.zh: 這飯店很貴。然而，房間很小。
mc.why: 新句子開頭用 However + 逗號。

mc.q: We went out in spite ___ the storm.
mc.zh: 儘管有暴風雨，我們還是出門了。
mc.why: in spite of + 名詞。

err.s: [Despite|Although] it was raining, they played soccer.
err.zh: 雖然在下雨，他們還是踢足球。
err.why: 後面是子句，要用連接詞 although。

err.s: Although he is young, [but he|he] is very responsible.
err.zh: 雖然他很年輕，卻很負責。
err.why: although 和 but 不能同時用。

err.s: Despite [she was|being] busy, she helped me.
err.zh: 儘管很忙，她還是幫了我。
err.why: despite 後面接名詞或 V-ing，不能接子句。

err.s: [Despite|Although] he was hungry, he didn't eat.
err.zh: 雖然他餓了，他卻沒吃東西。
err.why: 後面接子句，要用 although。

err.s: In spite [the|of the] rain, the game continued.
err.zh: 儘管下雨，比賽還是繼續。
err.why: in spite 後面要加 of。

err.s: Although she was busy, [but she|she] helped me.
err.zh: 雖然她很忙，還是幫了我。
err.why: although 和 but 不能同時用。

err.s: I wanted to go. [Although|However], I was too tired.
err.why: 新句子開頭的「然而」用 However。

mkZh: although 和 but 不能同時使用。
新句子開頭的「然而」要用 However，although 不能這樣用。
however 不能接 V-ing；表示「儘管」用 Although + 子句（或 Despite being）。

zh.p:
as + 形容詞／副詞原級 + as 表示兩者程度「一樣」。中間一定用原級，不能用比較級。
Amy is as tall as her mother.（艾咪和她媽媽一樣高。）

head: 句型
意思
例句
rows: This bag is as heavy as that one.
He runs as fast as a deer.
not as / so + 原級 + as
I am not as tall as my brother.
as + many / much + 名詞 + as
She has as many books as I do.
This room is twice as big as mine.
zh.note: not as … as = 比較級的反面：I'm not as tall as my brother. = My brother is taller than me.

zh.p: 看中間修飾的是什麼：

head: 句子
修飾
用
rows: She is as ___ as her sister.
She sings as ___ as her sister.

zh.p: 後面的比較對象常用主格＋助動詞：She's as tall as I am.；口語也常說 as tall as me。

mc.q: My English is not as ___ as yours.
mc.zh: 我的英文沒有你的好。
mc.why: as … as 中間用原級 good。

mc.q: He can swim as ___ as a fish.
mc.zh: 他游得像魚一樣快。
mc.why: fast 是副詞也是形容詞，as … as 中間用原級。

mc.q: This box is ___ as heavy as that one.
mc.zh: 這個箱子是那個的三倍重。
mc.why: 倍數放在 as … as 前面：three times as heavy as。

mc.q: Please reply as soon ___ possible.
mc.zh: 請盡快回覆。
mc.why: 固定說法 as soon as possible。

mc.q: Your bag is as ___ as mine.
mc.zh: 你的包包和我的一樣重。
mc.why: as … as 中間用原級。

mc.q: He doesn't run as ___ as his brother.
mc.zh: 他跑得沒有他哥哥快。
mc.why: as … as 中間用原級 fast。

mc.q: She has as ___ books as a library.
mc.zh: 她的書跟圖書館一樣多。
mc.why: books 可數，用 as many as。

mc.q: My room is half as big ___ yours.
mc.zh: 我的房間只有你的一半大。
mc.why: 倍數 + as … as。

err.s: My bike is as [newer|new] as yours.
err.zh: 我的腳踏車和你的一樣新。
err.why: as … as 中間要用原級 new。

err.s: She speaks English as [fluent|fluently] as a native speaker.
err.zh: 她英文說得和母語人士一樣流利。
err.why: 修飾動詞 speaks 要用副詞 fluently。

err.s: Your phone is as expensive [than|as] mine.
err.zh: 你的手機和我的一樣貴。
err.why: as … as 前後都要用 as，不能用 than。

err.s: This box is as [bigger|big] as that one.
err.zh: 這個箱子和那個一樣大。
err.why: as … as 中間用原級。

err.s: She sings as [beautiful|beautifully] as a bird.
err.why: 修飾動詞 sings 要用副詞。

err.s: I don't have as [many|much] money as you.
err.why: money 不可數，用 as much as。

err.s: Tom is not as tall [than|as] Ken.
err.why: as … as 後半要用 as。

mkZh: as … as 中間用原級 tall。
否定說 not as tall as，後面不能接 than。
as … as 的後半一樣用 as。

zh.p: 比較兩者用比較級（…比…更），比較三者以上中「最」的用最高級。

head: 種類
公式
例句
rows: A + be + 比較級 + than + B
Tom is the tallest in the class.

head: 規則
原級
比較級
最高級
rows: 短母音＋單子音：重複字尾
zh.cap: 比較級與最高級的變化

head: ✗ 錯誤
✓ 正確
原因
rows: 不能同時用 more 和 -er
不能同時用 most 和 -est

zh.p: 比較級前面可以加 much, a lot, far, even, a little 表示程度：This phone is much cheaper than that one.（✗ very cheaper）
最高級的範圍：in + 地方／團體（in my class, in the world）；of + 同類（of all the students, of the three）。

mc.q: Taipei 101 is ___ than this building.
mc.zh: 台北 101 比這棟大樓高。
mc.why: 兩者比較用比較級 + than。

mc.q: This is ___ movie I have ever seen.
mc.zh: 這是我看過最好看的電影。
mc.why: good 的最高級是不規則的 best。

mc.q: Math is ___ than English for me.
mc.zh: 對我來說數學比英文難。
mc.why: 三音節的 difficult 用 more 形成比較級。

mc.q: Your bag is ___ heavier than mine.
mc.zh: 你的包包比我的重很多。
mc.why: 加強比較級用 much，不用 very。

mc.q: This is the ___ day of the year.
mc.zh: 今天是一年中最熱的一天。
mc.why: 單音節的最高級：hot → hottest。

mc.q: My sister is ___ than me.
mc.zh: 我姊姊比我聰明。
mc.why: 單音節加 -er。

mc.q: This book is ___ interesting than that one.
mc.zh: 這本書比那本有趣。
mc.why: 長形容詞用 more 形成比較級。

mc.q: Today is ___ than yesterday.
mc.zh: 今天比昨天糟糕。
mc.why: bad 的比較級是 worse。

err.s: My room is [more bigger|bigger] than yours.
err.why: 不能同時用 more 和 -er。

err.s: She is the [most smart|smartest] student in our class.
err.zh: 她是我們班最聰明的學生。
err.why: 單音節形容詞的最高級加 -est。

err.s: Today is [hoter|hotter] than yesterday.
err.why: hot 是短母音＋單子音，要重複 t 再加 -er。

err.s: Kaohsiung is [hoter|hotter] than Taipei.
err.why: hot 要重複 t 再加 -er。

err.s: She is the [most happy|happiest] girl in the world.
err.zh: 她是世界上最快樂的女孩。
err.why: happy 的最高級是 happiest。

err.s: This test was [more easy|easier] than the last one.
err.why: easy 的比較級是 easier。

err.s: My house is [very bigger|much bigger] than yours.
err.why: 加強比較級用 much，不用 very。

mkZh: 不能同時用 more 和 -er，直接說 cheaper。
比較用 than，then 是「然後」。
good 的最高級是 best。

zh.p: either…or 和 neither…nor 是「成對」出現的連接詞，用來連接兩個選項。

head: 連接詞
意思
例句
rows: 不是 A 就是 B（二選一）
You can have either cake or ice cream.
She is not only smart but also kind.
zh.note: 配對不能拆錯：either 配 or，neither 配 nor，both 配 and。

zh.p: neither…nor 本身就有「不」的意思，句子裡不能再加 not / don't：

head: ✗ 錯誤
✓ 正確
rows: I don't like neither coffee nor tea.

zh.p: 當 either…or / neither…nor 連接兩個主詞時，動詞跟著靠近動詞的那個主詞（就近原則）：

head: 句子
動詞跟著
rows: Neither my parents nor my sister likes fish.
Neither my sister nor my parents like fish.

head: 用法
例句
rows: either / neither of + 複數名詞
I don't like it. — Neither do I.

zh.p: 肯定的「也」用 too / so：I like it. — Me too. / So do I.

mc.q: You can pay ___ by cash or by card.
mc.zh: 你可以付現或刷卡。
mc.why: 二選一用 either…or。

mc.q: Neither Ken nor his brothers ___ to swim.
mc.zh: 肯和他的兄弟們都不會游泳。
mc.why: 就近原則：動詞跟著 his brothers（複數）。

mc.q: I don't like horror movies. — ___ do I.
mc.zh: 我不喜歡恐怖片。我也不喜歡。
mc.why: 否定的「我也不」用 Neither do I。

mc.q: She speaks not only English ___ Japanese.
mc.zh: 她不只會說英文，還會說日文。
mc.why: not only A but also B。

mc.q: ___ my mom nor my dad can cook.
mc.zh: 我媽和我爸都不會煮飯。
mc.why: 「兩者都不」用 neither…nor。

mc.q: You can take ___ the bus or the train.
mc.zh: 你可以搭公車或火車。
mc.why: 二選一用 either…or。

mc.q: I can't swim. — I can't ___.
mc.zh: 我不會游泳。我也不會。
mc.why: 否定句的「也」用 either。

mc.q: ___ Amy and her sister are good at math.
mc.zh: 艾咪和她妹妹數學都很好。
mc.why: 「兩者都」用 both…and。

err.s: You can choose either the red one [nor|or] the blue one.
err.zh: 你可以選紅色的或藍色的。
err.why: either 要和 or 配對。

err.s: I [don't eat neither|eat neither] meat nor fish.
err.why: neither…nor 已經是否定，不能再加 don't。

err.s: Neither the teacher nor the students [was|were] late.
err.zh: 老師和學生都沒有遲到。
err.why: 就近原則，動詞跟著 the students（複數）。

err.s: Neither Tom [or|nor] Ken was at school.
err.why: neither 要和 nor 配對。

err.s: Either you or he [are|is] going to win.
err.why: 就近原則，動詞跟著 he，用 is。

err.s: I don't like it. — [So|Neither] do I.
err.why: 否定的「我也不」用 Neither do I。

err.s: She [doesn't speak neither|speaks neither] French nor German.
err.zh: 她法文和德文都不會說。
err.why: neither…nor 已經是否定，不能再加 doesn't。

mkZh: neither…nor 已經是否定，不能再加 don't。
either 要和 or 配對。
neither of them 正式用單數動詞 is。

zh.h: 第一條件句：未來真的可能發生

zh.p:
第一條件句說的是未來有可能發生的情況和它的結果。
公式：If + 現在簡單式, will + 原形動詞
If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home.（如果明天下雨，我們就待在家。）

head: 主要子句
例句
意思
rows: If you hurry, you might catch the bus.
If you feel sick, you should see a doctor.
If you see Amy, tell her to call me.

zh.p: 這是第一條件句最常見的錯誤：雖然說的是未來，if 子句仍用現在式。

head: ✗ 錯誤
✓ 正確
rows: If it will rain, we'll cancel.

zh.p: 同樣的規則也適用於 when, as soon as, before, after, until 引導的時間子句：I'll call you as soon as I arrive.
unless 表示「除非、如果不」，本身已經是否定，後面不能再加 not：
✗ Unless you don't hurry… 雙重否定，意思會相反。

zh.h: 第一 vs. 第二條件句

head: 第一條件句
第二條件句
rows: If I have time, I will help you.
If I had time, I would help you.（但我沒時間）

mc.q: If you ___ hard, you'll pass the exam.
mc.zh: 如果你用功，就會通過考試。
mc.why: if 子句用現在式表示未來。

mc.q: If it's sunny tomorrow, we ___ to the beach.
mc.zh: 如果明天天氣好，我們就去海邊。
mc.why: 第一條件句的主要子句用 will + 原形。

mc.q: ___ you leave now, you'll miss the train.
mc.zh: 除非你現在出發，不然會錯過火車。
mc.why: unless = if … not，「除非」。

mc.q: I'll call you as soon as I ___ the results.
mc.zh: 我一拿到結果就打給你。
mc.why: as soon as 引導的時間子句，用現在式表示未來。

mc.q: If you ___ now, you'll catch the bus.
mc.zh: 你現在出發的話，就趕得上公車。
mc.why: if 子句用現在式。

mc.q: If she doesn't study, she ___ the test.
mc.zh: 她不讀書的話會考不過。
mc.why: 主要子句用 will（won't）+ 原形。

mc.q: ___ it rains, we'll stay inside.
mc.zh: 如果下雨，我們就待在室內。
mc.why: 表示條件「如果」用 If。

mc.q: I'll text you as soon as I ___ there.
mc.zh: 我一到那裡就傳訊息給你。
mc.why: as soon as 引導的時間子句用現在式。

err.s: If you [will need|need] help, call me.
err.zh: 如果你需要幫忙，打給我。
err.why: if 子句用現在式，不用 will。

err.s: If she studies hard, she [passes|will pass] the test.
err.zh: 如果她用功，她就會通過考試。
err.why: 對未來的預測，主要子句用 will + 原形。

err.s: Unless you [don't wear|wear] a coat, you'll catch a cold.
err.zh: 除非你穿外套，不然會感冒。
err.why: unless 已經是否定，後面不能再加 don't。

err.s: If you [will be|are] late, the teacher will be angry.
err.zh: 如果你遲到，老師會生氣。
err.why: if 子句用現在式。

err.s: If I see Amy, I [tell|will tell] her the news.
err.zh: 如果我遇到艾咪，我會告訴她這個消息。
err.why: 主要子句用 will + 原形。

err.s: Unless you [don't|] practice, you won't improve.
err.zh: 不練習的話，你不會進步。
err.why: unless 已經是否定，不能再加 don't。

err.s: We'll go to the beach if the weather [will be|is] nice.
err.zh: 天氣好的話我們就去海邊。
err.why: if 子句用現在式。

mkZh: if 子句用現在式 rains，不用 will。
if 子句用現在式，主要子句才用 will：If you study, you'll pass。
unless 已經含「不」，後面不能再加 don't。

zh.h: for 和 since：持續多久？從什麼時候？

zh.p: 現在完成式常搭配 for 或 since，說明一件事持續到現在。

head: for
since
rows: for two hours, for three days, for ten years, for a long time
since 8 a.m., since Monday, since 2020, since last year
zh.note: 判斷法：能回答「多久」的是時間長度 → for；能回答「從何時」的是時間點 → since。

zh.h: since 後面也可以接句子

zh.p:
since 後面可以接過去式子句，表示「自從…以來」：
I have known her since we were kids.
She has changed a lot since she moved to Taipei.
公式：主要子句（現在完成式）+ since + 子句（過去簡單式）。
中文說「我住這裡五年了」，英文不能用現在式：

head: ✗ 錯誤
✓ 正確
rows: I live here for five years.
I have lived here for five years.

zh.p: How long have you studied English? — For six years. / Since I was seven.
It has been three years since I last saw him.（自從我上次見到他已經三年了。）

mc.q: We have been friends ___ elementary school.
mc.zh: 我們從小學就是朋友了。
mc.why: elementary school 是起始時間點，用 since。

mc.q: She has worked at this hospital ___ ten years.
mc.zh: 她在這家醫院工作十年了。
mc.why: ten years 是時間長度，用 for。

mc.q: I ___ him since I was five.
mc.zh: 我從五歲就認識他了。
mc.why: 持續到現在，用現在完成式。

mc.q: It has been a long time ___ we last met.
mc.zh: 自從我們上次見面已經很久了。
mc.why: It has been + 時間 + since + 子句。

mc.q: I haven't seen her ___ last summer.
mc.zh: 我從去年夏天就沒見過她。
mc.why: last summer 是時間點，用 since。

mc.q: He has played the guitar ___ a long time.
mc.zh: 他彈吉他很久了。
mc.why: a long time 是時間長度，用 for。

mc.q: They ___ married for twenty years.
mc.zh: 他們結婚二十年了。
mc.why: 持續到現在，用現在完成式。

mc.q: It has been two years ___ we moved here.
mc.zh: 我們搬來這裡已經兩年了。
mc.why: It has been + 時間 + since + 子句。

err.s: I have studied here [since|for] two years.
err.why: two years 是一段時間長度，用 for。

err.s: They [are|have been] married since 2010.
err.zh: 他們從 2010 年就結婚了。
err.why: 持續到現在要用現在完成式 have been。

err.s: He has played tennis [for|since] he was a child.
err.why: 後面是表示起點的子句，用 since。

err.s: I have lived here [since|for] ten years.
err.why: ten years 是時間長度，用 for。

err.s: She has worked here [for|since] 2019.
err.zh: 她從 2019 年就在這裡工作。
err.why: 2019 是時間點，用 since。

err.s: We [know|have known] each other since childhood.
err.why: 持續到現在，用現在完成式。

err.s: He has been sick [since three days|for three days].
err.why: three days 是時間長度，用 for。

mkZh: three days 是時間長度，用 for。
Monday 是起始時間點，用 since。
持續到現在要用現在完成式 I've lived。

zh.p:
當一件未來的事已經安排好（訂了票、約好時間、排進行事曆），英文常用現在進行式來說，而且一定要搭配未來時間詞。
I'm meeting my friend tomorrow.（我明天要跟朋友見面——已經約好了。）

head: 說法
語意
例句
rows: 已經安排好，有確定的時間地點
I'm flying to Tokyo on Friday.（機票訂了）
I'm going to learn Japanese.（有這個打算）

zh.p: 沒有時間詞時，現在進行式會被當成「現在正在做」：

head: 句子
意思
rows: 我今晚要跟 Ken 吃晚餐。

head: 問句
意思
rows: What are you doing this weekend?
Are you coming to the party?

zh.p: 公式和現在進行式完全一樣：am / is / are + V-ing。不要漏掉 be 動詞或 -ing。

mc.q: I can't come on Saturday. I ___ my grandparents.
mc.zh: 我星期六不能來，我要去看爺爺奶奶。
mc.why: 已經安排好的未來行程，用現在進行式。

mc.q: The movie ___ at 7:15 tonight.
mc.zh: 電影今晚 7:15 開始。
mc.why: 時刻表、節目表用現在簡單式。

mc.q: What ___ you doing after school tomorrow?
mc.zh: 你明天放學後要做什麼？
mc.why: 問已安排的計畫：What are you doing…?

mc.q: She is ___ to London next week.
mc.zh: 她下週要飛去倫敦。
mc.why: 現在進行式要用 V-ing。

mc.q: We ___ dinner with our cousins on Sunday.
mc.zh: 我們星期天要和表親吃晚餐。
mc.why: 已安排好的計畫，用現在進行式。

mc.q: Our flight ___ at 6:40 a.m.
mc.zh: 我們的班機早上 6:40 起飛。
mc.why: 班機時刻表用現在簡單式。

mc.q: Are you ___ to Ken's party tonight?
mc.zh: 你今晚會去肯的派對嗎？
mc.why: 現在進行式問未來安排：Are you coming…?

mc.q: I can't meet you tomorrow. I ___ the dentist.
mc.zh: 我明天不能跟你見面，我要去看牙醫。
mc.why: 已約好的行程，用現在進行式。

err.s: We [meet|are meeting] the new teacher tomorrow morning.
err.zh: 我們明天早上要見新老師。
err.why: 已經安排好的未來行程，用現在進行式。

err.s: My cousin is [come|coming] to visit next weekend.
err.why: 現在進行式要用 V-ing。

err.s: They [having|are having] a party on Saturday.
err.why: 不能少了 be 動詞 are。

err.s: She [visits|is visiting] her grandma this weekend.
err.why: 已安排好的計畫，用現在進行式。

err.s: What [do you do|are you doing] tomorrow night?
err.why: 問已安排的計畫：What are you doing…?

err.s: They are [move|moving] to Taichung next month.
err.zh: 他們下個月要搬去台中。
err.why: 現在進行式要用 V-ing。

err.s: My brother [arriving|is arriving] at noon.
err.why: 不能少了 be 動詞 is。

mkZh: 已經約好的事，用現在進行式 I'm meeting。
現在進行式要用 V-ing：is flying。
現在進行式要用 V-ing：are going。

zh.h: 未來進行式：未來某時「正在」做

zh.p:
公式：will be + V-ing。描述未來某個時間點正在進行的動作。
This time tomorrow, I will be flying to Tokyo.（明天這個時候，我正在飛往東京。）

zh.h: 未來完成式：未來某時「已經完成」

zh.p:
公式：will have + 過去分詞。表示到了未來某個時間點之前，某事已經完成。
By next June, I will have graduated.（到明年六月，我就已經畢業了。）

head: 未來進行式
未來完成式
rows: at 8 tonight, this time next week
by + 時間, by the time…, before
By 9 p.m., I will have finished studying.
zh.cap: 未來進行式 vs. 未來完成式

zh.h: by 是未來完成式的好朋友

zh.p: by 表示「在…之前、最晚到…」，看到 by + 未來時間，通常要用未來完成式：

head: 說法
例句
rows: I will have read the book by tomorrow.
by the end of this year
We will have saved enough money by the end of this year.
By the time you arrive, we will have eaten.
zh.note: by the time 後面的子句用現在式（不用 will）。

zh.p: Will you be using…? 是很客氣的詢問方式，問對方的安排而不是要求。

mc.q: Don't call me at 8. I ___ dinner then.
mc.zh: 八點別打給我，那時我正在吃晚餐。
mc.why: 未來某時刻正在做，用 will be + V-ing。

mc.q: By the end of this month, I ___ this novel.
mc.zh: 到這個月底，我就會讀完這本小說。
mc.why: by + 未來時間，表示「之前已完成」，用未來完成式。

mc.q: By the time you get here, the movie ___.
mc.zh: 等你到的時候，電影已經開始了。
mc.why: by the time 後用現在式，主要子句用未來完成式。

mc.q: This time next week, we ___ on the beach.
mc.zh: 下週這個時候，我們正躺在海灘上。
mc.why: this time next week：那時正在做，用未來進行式。

mc.q: At 10 a.m. tomorrow, we ___ a math test.
mc.zh: 明天早上十點我們正在考數學。
mc.why: 未來某時刻正在做，用未來進行式。

mc.q: By the time you wake up, I ___ for Taipei.
mc.zh: 等你醒來時，我已經出發去台北了。
mc.why: by the time + 現在式，主要子句用未來完成式。

mc.q: ___ you be using the computer tonight?
mc.zh: 你今晚會用到電腦嗎？
mc.why: 禮貌詢問對方的安排：Will you be using…?

mc.q: She will have ___ her degree by next June.
mc.zh: 到明年六月她就會拿到學位了。
mc.why: will have + p.p.。

err.s: By 2030, scientists [will find|will have found] a cure.
err.zh: 到 2030 年，科學家將已找到解藥。
err.why: by + 未來時間，表示之前已完成，用未來完成式。

err.s: At noon tomorrow, I will be [take|taking] a test.
err.why: 未來進行式是 will be + V-ing。

err.s: She will have [went|gone] home by six.
err.zh: 她六點前就會已經回家了。
err.why: will have 後面接過去分詞 gone。

err.s: By next week, I [will read|will have read] the whole book.
err.zh: 到下週，我就會讀完整本書了。
err.why: by + 未來時間，表示之前已完成，用未來完成式。

err.s: This time tomorrow, we will be [fly|flying] to Bangkok.
err.zh: 明天這個時候，我們正在飛往曼谷。
err.why: will be + V-ing。

err.s: They will have [ate|eaten] dinner by eight.
err.zh: 他們八點前就會吃完晚餐。
err.why: will have 後面接過去分詞 eaten。

err.s: Don't call at nine. I [will sleep|will be sleeping] then.
err.zh: 九點別打來，那時我正在睡覺。
err.why: 未來某時刻正在進行，用 will be sleeping。

mkZh: by next year 表示之前已完成，用未來完成式 will have finished。
will be 後面接 V-ing：will be finishing。
will have 後面接過去分詞 gone。

zh.h: 未來完成進行式：到未來某時已經持續了多久

zh.p:
公式：will have been + V-ing。表示一個動作到了未來某個時間點時，已經持續了一段時間（可能還會繼續）。
By June, I will have been working here for five years.（到六月，我就在這裡工作滿五年了。）

head: 時態
公式
持續到
例句
rows: I had been waiting for 20 minutes when she came.
By 3 p.m., I will have been waiting for an hour.

zh.p:
未來完成進行式通常同時有兩個時間資訊：
  • 未來的時間點：by + 時間、by the time + 現在式、next year…
  • 持續多久：for + 一段時間
By the time he retires, he will have been teaching for 40 years.

zh.h: 未來完成式 vs. 未來完成進行式

head: 未來完成式
未來完成進行式
rows: By June, I will have read 20 books.
By June, I will have been reading for 6 months.

zh.p: 狀態動詞（know, own, believe）不用進行式：By then, she will have known him for ten years.

head: ✗ 錯誤
✓ 正確
rows: By June, I will work here for five years.
By June, I will have been working here for five years.
They will have been drive for hours.
They will have been driving for hours.
will have been（will 後一律用原形 have）

mc.q: By next month, we ___ in this house for ten years.
mc.zh: 到下個月，我們就在這間房子住滿十年了。
mc.why: 到未來某時已持續多久，用 will have been V-ing。

mc.q: By 5 p.m., she will have been ___ for eight hours.
mc.zh: 到下午五點，她就已經工作了八小時。
mc.why: will have been 後面接 V-ing。

mc.q: By the time he arrives, I ___ for two hours.
mc.zh: 等他到的時候，我就已經等了兩個小時。
mc.why: by the time + 現在式；主要子句用未來完成進行式。

mc.q: By then, I ___ her for twenty years.
mc.zh: 到那時，我就認識她二十年了。
mc.why: know 是狀態動詞，用未來完成式。

mc.q: By December, she ___ English for ten years.
mc.zh: 到十二月，她學英文就滿十年了。
mc.why: 到未來某時已持續多久，用 will have been V-ing。

mc.q: By the time you arrive, I will have been ___ for two hours.
mc.zh: 等你到的時候，我已經工作兩小時了。
mc.why: will have been + V-ing。

mc.q: Next month, we ___ in this town for five years.
mc.zh: 下個月我們就在這個鎮上住滿五年了。
mc.why: 有 for five years，到未來某時已持續多久。

mc.q: By 2030, he ___ his company for twenty years.
mc.zh: 到 2030 年，他就擁有這家公司二十年了。
mc.why: own 是狀態動詞，用未來完成式。

err.s: Next year, he [will teach|will have been teaching] here for 30 years.
err.zh: 明年他就在這裡教書滿三十年了。
err.why: 有 for 30 years 表示到未來某時已持續多久，要用未來完成進行式。

err.s: By noon, the kids will have been [swim|swimming] for three hours.
err.zh: 到中午，孩子們就已經游了三個小時。
err.why: will have been 後面接 V-ing。

err.s: She [will has|will have] been studying for six hours by midnight.
err.zh: 到午夜她就讀了六個小時了。
err.why: will 後面一律用原形 have。

err.s: By 6 p.m., they [will drive|will have been driving] for ten hours.
err.zh: 到下午六點，他們就已經開了十小時的車。
err.why: 有 for ten hours 表示到未來某時已持續多久，用未來完成進行式。

err.s: By June, I will have been [teach|teaching] here for three years.
err.zh: 到六月，我就在這裡教書滿三年了。
err.why: will have been 後面接 V-ing。

err.s: She [will have being|will have been] studying for hours by midnight.
err.zh: 到午夜她就已經讀了好幾個小時了。
err.why: will have 後面接 been。

err.s: By then, we [will have been knowing|will have known] each other for a decade.
err.zh: 到那時，我們就認識十年了。
err.why: know 是狀態動詞，用未來完成式。

mkZh: 到 June 已持續五年，用 will have been working。
will have been 後面接 V-ing：driving。
know 是狀態動詞，用未來完成式 will have known。

zh.p: 英文說未來最常用 will 和 be going to，兩者常可以互換，但有些情況意思不同。

head: 用途
will
be going to
rows: ✓ The phone is ringing. I'll get it.
✓ I'm going to visit Japan next month.
有證據的預測（看得到跡象）
✓ Look at the clouds! It's going to rain.
✓ I'll help you. / Will you marry me?

head: 句型
will
be going to
zh.cap: will 與 be going to 的句型
zh.note: will 後面直接接原形（不加 to）；be going to 的 be 要跟著主詞變化（am / is / are）。

zh.p: tomorrow, tonight, next week, soon, in two days, this weekend, someday, in the future
時間和條件子句（when, if, before, after）裡，即使是未來也用現在式：I'll call you when I get home.（✗ will get）

mc.q: I've bought the tickets. We ___ see a movie tonight.
mc.zh: 我買好票了，今晚我們要去看電影。
mc.why: 已經計畫好的事，用 be going to。

mc.q: You look thirsty. I ___ get you some water.
mc.zh: 你看起來很渴，我去幫你倒杯水。
mc.why: 說話當下才決定，用 will。

mc.q: Look out! That glass ___ fall!
mc.zh: 小心！那個杯子要掉了！
mc.why: 看得到跡象的預測，用 be going to。

mc.q: I'll text you when I ___ home.
mc.zh: 我到家時會傳訊息給你。
mc.why: when 引導的時間子句，未來也用現在式。

mc.q: I'm tired. I think I ___ go to bed.
mc.zh: 我累了，我想我要去睡了。
mc.why: 說話當下才決定，用 will。

mc.q: She ___ visit her grandparents next weekend. She's already bought the tickets.
mc.zh: 她下週末要去看爺爺奶奶，票已經買好了。
mc.why: 事先計畫好的，用 be going to。

mc.q: Look at that car! It ___ crash!
mc.zh: 看那輛車！要撞上了！
mc.why: 看得到跡象的預測，用 be going to。

mc.q: Don't worry. I ___ tell anyone.
mc.zh: 別擔心，我不會告訴任何人。
mc.why: 承諾用 will；否定是 won't。

err.s: She [will goes|will go] to the dentist tomorrow.
err.why: will 後面接原形動詞 go。

err.s: We [going to|are going to] have a test on Friday.
err.why: be going to 不能少了 be 動詞。

err.s: I'll call you after I [will finish|finish] my homework.
err.zh: 我寫完功課後會打給你。
err.why: after 引導的時間子句，用現在式表示未來。

err.s: I [will to|will] call you later.
err.why: will 後面接原形。

err.s: They [is going to|are going to] build a new library.
err.zh: 他們要蓋一座新圖書館。
err.why: They 配 are。

err.s: When I [will grow|grow] up, I want to be a pilot.
err.why: when 引導的時間子句用現在式表示未來。

err.s: She [won't comes|won't come] to the party.
err.why: won't 後面接原形。

mkZh: will 後面直接接原形動詞，不加 to。
be going to 要有 be 動詞：She is going to。
眼前有明顯跡象的預測，用 be going to。

zh.h: 連接詞 vs. 轉折副詞

zh.p: 「雖然、但是、因此、而且」在英文裡分成兩種字，標點符號規則完全不同，是寫作最常扣分的地方。

head: 種類
例字
功能
標點
rows: although, because, but, so, and, while
前面句號或分號，後面逗號

head: 意思
連接詞（一句）
轉折副詞（兩句）
rows: Although it was late, we kept talking.
It was late. However, we kept talking.
She is smart, and she is kind.
She is smart. Moreover, she is kind.

zh.p: however 是副詞，不能像 but 一樣直接用逗號連接兩個句子：

head: ✗ 錯誤
✓ 正確
rows: It was expensive, however, I bought it.
It was expensive. However, I bought it.
It was expensive; however, I bought it.
It was expensive, but I bought it.

zh.h: although 和 but 不能一起用

zh.p:
中文「雖然…但是…」英文只能選一個：
Although he was tired, he finished.（✗ Although he was tired, but he finished.）
however 不能放在子句前面當「雖然」：✗ However he was tired, he finished. → ✓ Although he was tired, he finished.
however + 形容詞 = 無論多麼：However hard I try, I can't do it.（這是另一個用法）

mc.q: ___ it was raining, we went hiking.
mc.zh: 雖然在下雨，我們還是去爬山了。
mc.why: 接一個子句表示「雖然」，用連接詞 although。

mc.q: The test was hard. ___, most students passed.
mc.zh: 考試很難。然而，大部分學生都及格了。
mc.why: 句號後面開新句子，用轉折副詞 However + 逗號。

mc.q: I missed the bus, ___ I was late for school.
mc.zh: 我錯過了公車，所以上學遲到了。
mc.why: 用逗號連接兩個子句時，要用連接詞 so。

mc.q: He studied hard. ___, he got an A.
mc.zh: 他很用功，因此拿到了 A。
mc.why: 新句子開頭表示結果，用 Therefore + 逗號。

mc.q: ___ he is young, he is very wise.
mc.zh: 雖然他很年輕，卻很有智慧。
mc.why: 接子句表示「雖然」，用 although。

mc.q: It was cold. ___, we went swimming.
mc.zh: 天氣很冷。然而，我們還是去游泳了。
mc.why: 新句子開頭的「然而」用 However。

mc.q: She was sick, ___ she stayed home.
mc.zh: 她生病了，所以待在家。
mc.why: 用逗號連接兩個子句，要用連接詞 so。

mc.q: The bus was late. ___, I missed the meeting.
mc.zh: 公車遲到了，因此我錯過了會議。
mc.why: 新句子開頭表示結果用 Therefore。

err.s: Although she was sick, [but she|she] came to school.
err.zh: 雖然她生病了，她還是來上學。
err.why: although 和 but 不能同時使用。

err.s: I wanted to go. [however,|However,] I was too busy.
err.why: however 開始新的句子，首字母要大寫。

err.s: [However|Although] the food was cheap, it was delicious.
err.zh: 雖然食物很便宜，但很好吃。
err.why: 放在子句前表示「雖然」要用 although。

err.s: Although the food was cheap, [but it|it] was delicious.
err.zh: 雖然食物很便宜，卻很好吃。
err.why: although 和 but 不能同時用。

err.s: It was late[, however,|. However,] we kept working.
err.zh: 很晚了。然而我們還是繼續工作。
err.why: however 不能用逗號接兩個句子，前面要用句號。

err.s: [However|Although] it rained, we had fun.
err.zh: 雖然下雨，我們還是玩得很開心。
err.why: 接子句表示「雖然」要用 although。

err.s: I studied hard[, therefore|, so] I passed.
err.why: 用逗號連接兩個子句要用連接詞 so；therefore 前面要用句號或分號。

mkZh: although 和 but 不能同時使用。
however 不能接子句當「雖然」，要用 although。
however 不能用逗號接兩個句子；前面要用句號（或分號）。

zh.h: 過去進行式：過去某一刻「正在」做

zh.p: 過去進行式描述過去某個時間點正在進行的動作。公式：主詞 + was / were + V-ing。

head: 句型
例句
rows: I was reading at 9 p.m. last night.
zh.note: I / he / she / it 配 was；you / we / they 配 were。

head: 用法
例句
rows: 正在做時，被另一件事打斷
I was taking a shower when the phone rang.
It was raining, and the wind was blowing.

zh.p: 長的動作（背景）用進行式，短的動作（打斷）用簡單式。

zh.h: 過去簡單式 vs. 過去進行式

head: 過去簡單式
過去進行式
rows: I read a book last night.（看完了）
I was reading a book last night.（那時在看）

zh.p: 狀態動詞（know, like, want…）不用進行式：I knew the answer.

mc.q: What ___ you doing at ten last night?
mc.zh: 你昨晚十點在做什麼？
mc.why: 主詞 you 配 were，過去進行式問句。

mc.q: I ___ dinner when the lights went out.
mc.zh: 停電的時候我正在吃晚餐。
mc.why: 被打斷的、正在進行的動作用過去進行式。

mc.q: While she was studying, her brother ___ games.
mc.zh: 她在讀書時，她弟弟在玩遊戲。
mc.why: 兩件事同時進行，都用過去進行式。

mc.q: We were walking home ___ it started to rain.
mc.zh: 我們走路回家時開始下雨了。
mc.why: 後面是短動作（started），用 when。

mc.q: It ___ when we left the house.
mc.zh: 我們出門時正在下雨。
mc.why: 背景、正在進行的動作用過去進行式。

mc.q: I was reading ___ my sister was watching TV.
mc.zh: 我在看書時，我妹妹在看電視。
mc.why: 兩個持續的動作同時進行，用 while。

mc.q: ___ you sleeping when I called?
mc.zh: 我打給你時你在睡覺嗎？
mc.why: you 配 were。

mc.q: He fell while he ___.
mc.zh: 他在跑步時跌倒了。
mc.why: while 後面接持續的動作，用過去進行式。

err.s: They [was|were] playing basketball at 4 p.m.
err.zh: 他們下午四點在打籃球。
err.why: They 是複數，配 were。

err.s: I was [sleep|sleeping] when you called.
err.zh: 你打電話來時我在睡覺。
err.why: 過去進行式要用 V-ing。

err.s: She [was knowing|knew] the answer.
err.why: know 是狀態動詞，不用進行式。

err.s: I [was|were] cooking when the phone rang.
err.why: I 配 was。

err.s: What were you [do|doing] at 9 p.m.?
err.why: 過去進行式要用 V-ing。

err.s: She was walking home [while|when] she saw an accident.
err.zh: 她走路回家時看到一場車禍。

mc.zh: 消防員到的時候，火已經熄了。

err.s: They [has|have] been playing games all afternoon.

err.why: They 用 have。

has been 後面接 V-ing。
know 是狀態動詞，用現在完成式 has known。

mc.q: If plants don't get water, they ___.
mc.zh: 植物如果沒有水就會死。
mc.why: 自然定律：兩邊都用現在式。

mc.q: ___ I eat too much, I feel sick.
mc.zh: 每當我吃太多就會不舒服。
mc.why: 一定成立的習慣，if 可換成 when。

mc.q: If you press this button, the machine ___.
mc.zh: 按下這個按鈕，機器就會啟動。
mc.why: 主詞 the machine 單數，現在式加 s。

mc.q: If you ___ 2 and 2, you get 4.
mc.zh: 2 加 2 等於 4。
mc.why: 數學事實用零條件句，if 子句用現在式。

mc.q: When it ___, the roads get slippery.
mc.zh: 下雨時路面會變滑。
mc.why: 一定成立的情況，用現在式。

mc.q: If you don't water plants, they ___.
mc.zh: 不澆水的話，植物會枯萎。
mc.why: 兩邊都用現在式。

mc.q: If I ___ too much coffee, I can't sleep.
mc.zh: 我喝太多咖啡就會睡不著。
mc.why: 個人習慣，零條件句用現在式。

err.s: If you [will mix|mix] yellow and blue, you get green.
err.zh: 黃色和藍色混在一起就會變成綠色。
err.why: 零條件句的 if 子句用現在式，不用 will。

err.s: If it [rained|rains], the streets get wet.
err.why: 兩邊都用現在式，時態要一致。

err.s: If my cat [hear|hears] a loud noise, it hides.
err.zh: 我的貓聽到大聲響就會躲起來。
err.why: 主詞 my cat 單數，動詞要加 s。

err.s: If you [will heat|heat] butter, it melts.
err.why: 零條件句的 if 子句用現在式。

err.s: If you touch fire, it [burned|burns] you.
err.why: 零條件句兩邊都用現在式。

err.s: When the baby [cry|cries], his mom feeds him.
err.why: 主詞 the baby 單數，加 -es。

err.s: If it [snowed|snows], the school closes.
err.zh: 下雪的話，學校就會停課。
err.why: 零條件句兩邊時態都用現在式。
